subject: rust-toolchain.toml
text: The repository pins toolchain channel 1.93.0 in rust-toolchain.toml, but .github/workflows/ci.yml installs the toolchain via dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable under a comment claiming it installs the exact pin.
